text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I let victory fall through my fingers last
time, but
things won't turn out like that
today!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've further trained these princess
muscles, and
now they're my ticket to a
crushing win!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will! So keep your eyes locked on this
princess's
gallant figure!
